judgment.status_reasoning: Signed on 30 Mar 2026 ('this 30th day of March 2026') and 'effective immediately'. EO N-9-26 of 18 Sep 2026 recites its issuance (stored for US-CA-09), and no stored file shows a revocation. Its 120-day deadlines have passed, but the order stays in force. Unchanged.
